About the Author关于作者

Abi Aryan is the founder of Abide AI and a machine learning research engineer with nearly a decade of experience building production-level ML systems. A mathematician by training, she previously served as a visiting research scholar at the Cognitive Systems Lab at UCLA, under Dr. Judea Pearl, where she focused on developing intelligent agents.

Abi Aryan 是 Abide AI 的创始人，也是一名机器学习研究工程师，拥有近十年构建生产级 ML 系统的经验。她是数学科班出身，曾作为访问研究学者在 UCLA 认知系统实验室跟随 Judea Pearl 博士工作，专注于开发智能体。

Abi has authored research papers in AutoML, multi-agent systems, and large language models, and actively reviews for leading research conferences and workshops, including NeurIPS, the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL), Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), and Advances in Approximate Bayesian Inference (AABI).

Abi 在 AutoML、多智能体系统和大语言模型领域发表过研究论文，并积极为顶尖研究会议和研讨会审稿，包括 NeurIPS、计算语言学协会（ACL）、自然语言处理实证方法（EMNLP）以及近似贝叶斯推断进展（AABI）。

She is currently advancing research in reflective intelligence in AI agents, distributed self-healing protocols for multi-agent systems, and GPU engineering for very-large-scale AI systems.

她目前的研究方向包括 AI 智能体中的反思智能、多智能体系统的分布式自愈协议，以及超大规模 AI 系统的 GPU 工程。

Colophon版权页（版本说明）

The animal on the cover of LLMOps is a lionfish. Lionfish belong to the genus Pterois, a group of venomous fish native to the Indo-Pacific. Like most venomous animals, lionfish have warning coloration: boldly contrasting bands of red or black with white stripes. The genus name Pterois, French for fins, refers to their ostentatious dorsal fins, which are tipped with venomous spines.

《LLMOps》封面上的动物是一条狮子鱼。狮子鱼属于 Pterois 属，是原产于印度-太平洋的一类有毒鱼类。和多数有毒动物一样，狮子鱼有警告色：红或黑与白色条纹大胆对比的色带。属名 Pterois 在法语中意为“鳍”，指它们华丽的、顶端有毒刺的背鳍。

Lionfish live between 5 and 15 years. Females can lay up to two million eggs per year. They eat small fish, invertebrates, and mollusks. They are territorial and generally hostile toward other fish in their habitat. They've also reportedly been aggressive toward human divers and researchers.

狮子鱼寿命 5 到 15 年。雌鱼每年最多可产两百万枚卵。它们以小鱼、无脊椎动物和软体动物为食。它们有领地意识，对栖息地中的其他鱼通常怀有敌意。据报道它们对人类潜水员和研究人员也有攻击性。

There are 12 recognized species of lionfish. None are endangered. In some locations they are considered an invasive species, and their rapidly expanding populations are a concern. Many of the animals on O'Reilly covers are endangered; all of them are important to the world.

狮子鱼已知有 12 个物种，无一濒危。在某些地区它们被视为入侵物种，其快速扩张的种群令人担忧。O'Reilly 封面上的许多动物都濒临灭绝；它们对这个世界都很重要。

Color illustration by Monica Kamsvaag, based on an antique line engraving from Dover Pictorial Archive. The series design is by Edie Freedman, Ellie Volckhausen, and Karen Montgomery. The cover fonts are Gilroy Semibold and Guardian Sans. The text font is Adobe Minion Pro; the heading font is Adobe Myriad Condensed; and the code font is Dalton Maag's Ubuntu Mono.

彩色插画由 Monica Kamsvaag 绘制，蓝本为 Dover Pictorial Archive 的一幅古版画。丛书装帧由 Edie Freedman、Ellie Volckhausen 和 Karen Montgomery 设计。封面字体为 Gilroy Semibold 和 Guardian Sans。正文字体为 Adobe Minion Pro；标题字体为 Adobe Myriad Condensed；代码字体为 Dalton Maag 的 Ubuntu Mono。
